issues.description: The full SAS source still depends on unverified commercial tables, missing author-prepared inputs, the external winsor macro, historical public-source files and remote SAS capability.
The active %INCLUDE references an external winsor.sas macro that is not in the package inventory; its macro body and variable contract cannot be reconstructed from the call alone.
The frozen environment snapshot records SAS as unverified; it is not evidence of missing entitlement, and no SAS runtime attempt was made in this assignment.

The source includes a remote ZIP-distance transfer branch; SAS/CONNECT session/configuration and target-side semantics are not verified. The connection statement block is masked in the safe review, and no connection attempt occurred.
SAS/ACCESS PC Files support/licensing for the XLSX imports and DTA export is unverified; no license conclusion is drawn.
The source names Windows drive-letter input/output paths and an output-library macro; the target execution roots must be mapped to the supplied same-data files before a future run.
The 2018 z table import points to the same 2017 CSV path, while the datasheet reports a 2018 annual download; correct file/year intent requires author confirmation.

The final PROC EXPORT names a .dta output but omits an explicit DBMS identifier; SAS documentation lists DBMS=DTA for Stata files, so the intended export option should be explicit and PC Files support verified.

evidence.quote:
a) Compustat: while several iterations of downloads and analyses were performed for
      multiple drafts and presentations, the data in the current draft was downloaded
      7/6/2019 and final analysis performed on 9/16/2019.
   b) Audit Analytics: downloaded 7/6/2019 and final analysis on 9/16/2019
   c) www.transportation.gov: downloaded on 7/21/2017 for the years 2004-2016. Data
      for the year 2017 was pulled on 12/17/2018 and data for the 2018 year was
      downloaded on 2/2/2019. The Bureau of Transportation Statistics (bts.gov) houses
      the Transtats databases (https://www.transtats.bts.gov/). Specifically, we use the T-
      100 dataset by year for domestic flights.
   d) Drive times were collected from Maps.google.com on March 21, 2019 between 9pm
      and 4am.
   e) MSA locations, names, and identifiers were obtained from the United States Census
      Bureau. Locations are based on the CBSA files obtained from this website
      (https://www.census.gov/geographies/reference-files/time-series/demo/metro-
      micro/delineation-files.html). We obtained these data on 1/24/2015. All years based
      on the 2013 CBSA update.

	create table Compu as
	select distinct c.gvkey, c.cik, c.datadate, c.fyear, c.fyr, c.at, c.act, c.lct, c.emp, c.lt, c.invt, c.rect, c.ppegt, c.re, c.ebit,
					c.oiadp, c.fca, c.xido, c.spi, c.sale, c.revt, c.ceq, c.prcc_f, c.csho, c.ni, c.ib, c.tic, c.cusip, c.conm, c.oancf,
					c.aqc, c.rcp, c.rca, c.rceps, c.rcd, c.rea, c.pstk, c.sich, c.sstk, c.dltis, c.recch, c.invch, c.apalch, c.txach, c.aoloch, c.ppent,
					c.che, c.dlc, c.ivao, c.dltt, c.ivst, c.upstk,
					d.SIC, d.GIND, d.fyrc

proc sort data = F_Audit_Firm_Share; by auditor_fkey auditor_cbsa fyear; run; /**/
proc sort data = r_Office_size_b; by auditor_fkey auditor_cbsa fyear; run; /**/

Proc SQL; create table &library..Fee_info as
select e.*, f.office_size_fees + 1 as office_size_fees
from F_Audit_Firm_Share as e left join r_Office_size_b as f
on e.auditor_fkey = f.auditor_fkey and e.auditor_cbsa = f.auditor_cbsa and e.fyear = f.fyear;
quit; /*  */

data &library..Large_Offices; set &library..Fee_info;
where office_size_fees = 10; run; /**/
